adaptations.reason: Production GraphEdge.type is only depends-on|survey (graph-core/build.ts:39) — no claim->claim edge kind. Spec 003 §1 derivation assumed a typed claim->claim ref edge.
adaptations.decision: Single-pass walk over ClaimRecord.refs, snapshot-wide via Object.values(claimsByCell).flat(). Pure fn in reverse-index.ts unit-tested in isolation incl cross-cell source-in-A/target-in-B (reverse-index.test.ts:40-50).

adaptations.title: graph.query tool name + gaps envelope normalisation + typeof validation
adaptations.reason: Spec said og.call('query', {term}); production tool name is 'graph.query' with args {terms:[term]} and returns {candidates, gaps: string[]}. Spec assumed gap is object.
adaptations.decision: QueryBar calls og.call('graph.query', {terms:[term]}); queryClaims normalises gaps string[] -> {term, suggestions}. RETRY #1 adds typeof score === 'number' ? score : 0 and typeof domain === 'string' ? domain : null guarding render crashes; window counter moved behind import.meta.env.DEV; per-instance latest-request race guard prevents stale responses.

adaptations.reason: Server event payloads carry byUser=userId (u_<hex>) but lock.* carry holder and authority.demoted carries by — prior `??` chain missed lock/authority holders in filter.
adaptations.decision: matchesFilters unions all four slots via includes(); select option value is userId; history.replaceState on every filter change into #/history?user=&target=&kind=; round-trip e2e coverage in history.e2e.ts:83-109.

adaptations.title: claimsOfCell SQL pushdown + colon validation + file redaction + frozen claimsCount unit + snapshot scope
adaptations.reason: Spec required read-only ClaimsEnvelope. RETRY #1 found JS post-filter N+1 O(tenant), malformed-cell silent level-5 coercion, server file path disclosure.
adaptations.decision: Direct SQLite read with domain+level pushed into WHERE predicate (claimsOfCell); cell string validated to require 'domain:level' with non-empty halves + numeric level (throws on 'auth'/':P3'/'auth:'); redactFile strips repo prefix /src/ and absolute layout; new claimsOfSnapshot single bounded projection for snapshot-wide ReverseIndex; corrupt persisted refs parsed defensively (parseRefs). resources.test.ts covers: full body, missing cell, unknown cell, malformed rejection, file redaction, frozen claimsCount, snapshot scope, corrupt refs isolation.

adaptations.title: navigateToClaim cross-cell chip nav (setSelectedCell → openClaim → requestCenter)
adaptations.reason: Spec 003 §3+§21 broken in retry0: only openClaim(refId) called, no ownerCell lookup, no centering; cross-cell refs silently swallowed (e2e self-deprecated).
adaptations.decision: navigateToClaim scans claimsByCell for owner, setSelectedCell(ownerCell) BEFORE openClaim(refId), then requestCenter(ownerCell). Snapshot refresh via readSnapshotClaims(true) on miss. e2e asserts #claims-panel[data-cell=auth:P5] + .open-claim[data-id=cBase] + .referenced-by contains c1 (snapshot-wide reverse index).
